from solution import read_number


def test_zero():
    assert read_number(0) == '영'


def test_basic():
    assert read_number(1) == '일'
    assert read_number(10) == '십'
    assert read_number(11) == '십일'
    assert read_number(110) == '백십'
    assert read_number(2026) == '이천이십육'


def test_thousand_hundred():
    assert read_number(1000) == '천'
    assert read_number(100) == '백'
    assert read_number(1001) == '천일'
    assert read_number(9999) == '구천구백구십구'


def test_man():
    assert read_number(10000) == '만'
    assert read_number(20000) == '이만'
    assert read_number(11000) == '만천'
    assert read_number(10001) == '만일'
    assert read_number(110000) == '십일만'
    assert read_number(100000) == '십만'
    assert read_number(1000000) == '백만'
    assert read_number(10000000) == '천만'
    assert read_number(99999999) == '구천구백구십구만구천구백구십구'


def test_eok():
    assert read_number(100000000) == '일억'
    assert read_number(100010000) == '일억만'
    assert read_number(120000000) == '일억이천만'
    assert read_number(100000001) == '일억일'
    assert read_number(1000000000) == '십억'
    assert read_number(10**11) == '천억'


def test_max():
    assert read_number(10**12 - 1) == '구천구백구십구억구천구백구십구만구천구백구십구'


def test_eok_group_one_thousand_skip():
    assert read_number(110000000000) == '천백억'
    assert read_number(100000000000 + 10000) == '천억만'
